card.name: Equals sign ending a calculation
card.fires_on: The equals sign (or closing parenthesis just before the result) at the end of a written arithmetic expression, right where the computed answer comes next. Mostly dose or volume calculations with numbers multiplied or divided.

modes.label: Dose calculation result
modes.description: Equals sign after a multiplication or division of doses, weights or concentrations, just before the answer.

modes.label: Closing bracket before answer
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or equals sign after a multiplier, with the result following.

modes.label: Everyday arithmetic
modes.description: Equals sign in a simple non-drug sum.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a worked sum where the answer is about to be written.
